derivation: From pipeline/.cache/ofsted/nspl/nspl_latest.csv: districts with an active postcode in an English local authority (lad25cd starting E). Include ALL active postcodes in those districts, including across national borders: empty doterm, 49 <= lat <= 61, -9 <= long <= 2. Group pcds by outward code; store [min lat, min long, max lat, max long].
